faq.q: What is a food and drink video template?
faq.a: A ready scene for a pour, a cold glass, or a first sip. You add a photo of your bottle or can. You can add a voice, on-screen words, and background music before you post.

faq.q: How do I make the pour clip?
faq.a: Upload the package photo, or paste the product link. Name the glass and one action, such as a pour or a sip. Pick a size and a length. Add a voice or captions if you want them, then download or post.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of a kitchen shoot?
faq.a: The pour is built from the package photo you already have. You do not book a kitchen, a creator, or a new shoot to try the next flavor.
Drink sellers who need a pour, a cold glass, or a sip for a feed, a listing, or an ad.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Drink sellers who need a pour, a cold glass, or a sip for a social post, a product page, or an ad.
A sharp photo of the full bottle or can, with the shape, the cap, and the label area clear. You can also paste a public product link and use the bottle shown on that page.

faq.q: Can the clip show ice, a voice, and captions?
faq.a: Yes. A cold scene can show ice, bubbles, or drops on the glass, with the package beside the glass. A voice and captions can name the drink. The sip shows a serving moment. It is not a health claim.

faq.q: Which size can I pick, and where can I post it?
faq.a: Pick one size: tall 9:16, square 1:1, wide 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. 4:3 is a shorter wide size, and 3:4 is a little taller than a square. Use 6 seconds for one pour, or 10, 15, or 30 seconds for a longer sip. Send the file to TikTok, or to Meta (Facebook and Instagram), from your account. You can also download it. You see the credit cost before it starts.
A clip uses 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Credits are the balance on your monthly plan. If the clip fails, those credits come back. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Where do flavor and allergen lines go?
faq.a: Add the approved flavor, ingredients, allergy notes, and price as captions, or on the product page. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark, so our name is not stamped on the file. You can use it in your ads. A person on screen is an AI presenter, not a real customer.

faq.q: Can I make several at once, switch language, or use the API?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the same scene for a set of bottles. That is a batch. You can switch the spoken line and the captions to another language. The API lets your own shop software send the photos. Each one shows its credit cost first.

steps.prompt: A hand pours citrus soda from the silver can into one glass filled with ice. The shot starts at counter height and moves closer as the glass fills. Bright window light stays beside the can. The can and the full glass are both in the last shot. You hear a crisp fizz and a soft pour. Add background music if you want it. Keep the can's shape, color, and label as in your photo.
